description: Defines the SystemStatus class representing various system states within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, including static instances for each state and methods for equality and string representation.

classes.name: SystemStatus
classes.description: Represents various internal states of the system, with static instances for each state and methods for equality and string conversion.
